content: {"rule": "K-S2", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "UNDERDETERMINED -- the passive egennēthē (was born) with feminine hēs (of whom) admits both the withheld-father and the birth-narration readings", "why": "The judge's stated ground for the UNDERDETERMINED verdict is that the single verse Matthew 1:16 states neither the link (the withheld-father reading) nor its contrary (the birth-narration reading) but "admits both," which is exactly the ground K-S2 declares never available."}
